harbor_containerization.evidence: All tasks were staged and retained answers were container-replayed, but the preserved outbound proxy audit proves exact source-image bytes for only 158/240 scheduled attempts. The other 82 were pre-agent infrastructure failures (60 had only unrelated concurrent proxy images in their trial windows; 22 had none) and conservatively fail the mandatory image-use requirement.

deepseek_v4_1_flash_binary_accuracy.evidence: The mandatory all-scheduled result is 84/240 = 35.00%, with all 98 missing outcomes retained as zero. The non-primary 84/142 sensitivity and its simultaneous upper bound 68.49% show the strict <70% conclusion does not depend on counting infrastructure failures as zero. This accuracy pass cannot rescue the independent transport failure.

caveats: MATRIX releases no official vision rubric; the qualification measures a frozen adapter-derived binary task contract, not official benchmark accuracy.

The all-scheduled denominator remains mandatory. Of 98 missing outputs, 82 were pre-agent infrastructure failures, 12 rate-limit errors after image transport, and 4 max-iteration outcomes after image transport. The 84/142 retained-answer sensitivity is diagnostic only and does not replace the primary result.

Under the precommitted all-scheduled image requirement, this is a definitive transport failure.
